5.description: Much like the Lannisters of Casterly Rock, you now own a truly impressive gold mine. This gold mine could be mined for centuries - millennia perhaps without running dry. In addition, you own a mint which will print valid money for you from now on. Please be aware that this does not come with inflation protection, so you could truly wreck the economy if you spend too much.

5.__source: Celestial Song v2 by Gothicjedi666 - The Maester & Merchant
5.name: Gilded Sovereign
5.description: You have an unparalleled instinct for creating and growing wealth. From humble beginnings, you can build thriving cities, initiate booming trade networks, and enrich entire regions. Within a few years, a small port could become a thriving economic center. In time, your work could rival the prosperity of Braavos or Qarth. You seem to turn financial investments into empires, making you an economic visionary capable of completely reshaping the Westerosi financial landscape.

6.__source: Celestial Song v2 by Gothicjedi666 - The Smallfolk
6.name: The Winds of Winter
6.description: Your body possesses an incredible resilience, enabling you to thrive even in the harshest conditions. Native diseases hold little threat, and you endure brutal winters or food shortages with ease, maintaining strength and clarity where others falter. Sickness rarely takes hold, and starvation becomes a distant worry, as you instinctively ration energy and resources within yourself.

6.__source: Celestial Song v2 by Gothicjedi666 - The Smallfolk
6.name: The Raider
6.source: A Song of Ice and Fire: The Epoch of Legends
6.description: You’ve become friends with one of the greatest raiders of their time. Wielding a giant axe and hammer as their weapons, this ironclad warrior is powerful and remarkably dexterous, able to cave your skull in as easily as they can chop it off before you could react. On the sea, they have a blessing that keeps them from being killed by any adversary, assuming that they could be stopped anyway. Despite the name, and their somewhat aggressive behavior, they won’t actually do much raiding unless you are up for it.

6.__source: Celestial Song v2 by Gothicjedi666 - The Smallfolk
6.name: Musical Skill
6.description: The art of Song and Instruments, one you're quite talented at, to the point that many would compare your skill to the late Prince Rhaegar Targaryen. Weaving new songs and music comes as easy to you as winning the hearts and minds of your audience and you’ll find that you seem to never run out of inspiration; drawing ideas from your experiences and environment. To think, with this alone you could indeed make quite a lot of coin; though do be careful, not every King or Lord enjoys a good song.

6.__source: Celestial Song v2 by Gothicjedi666 - The Smallfolk
6.name: Frey Pies
6.description: You are a world class chef capable of making any material taste delicious, and masking any flavour. Literally any flavour.

6.__source: Celestial Song v2 by Gothicjedi666 - The Smallfolk
6.name: Tradecraft Skills
6.description: You have skills in a mundane trade of your choice which someone of Planetos of your political standing, geographic location and time could conceivably learn. This includes being a Myrrish glassmaker, a carpenter, a brewer or other such trades.

6.__source: Celestial Song v2 by Gothicjedi666 - The Smallfolk
6.name: Smith
6.description: You are a skilled blacksmith, capable of forging most things seen on Planetos. Items forged by you are better at their intended function in some way, with swords being sharper, ploughs ploughing more easily, armour blocking blows more easily, or decorative items being more eye-catching. Whilst

6.__source: Celestial Song v2 by Gothicjedi666 - The Smallfolk
6.name: Traveller’s Hospitality
6.description: A hearth to rest one’s feet at, and a table to eat and drink at, something we all desire and something many travellers don’t always get, is something you can get with ease. You have a bit of an aura that makes people open their doors to allow you to stay and rest for a bit so long as you aren’t a problem. Of course this can always be undone if you’re a monster who rapes and pillages his/her way across nations but then why would you be looking for fellowship?

6.__source: Celestial Song v2 by Gothicjedi666 - The Smallfolk
6.name: Guest Rites
6.description: By taking this perk, those with whom you make promises or agreements in good faith are far more likely to hold to them. This is strongest in promises not to attack you, but even then, sufficiently motivated or honorless individuals may break them. To break agreements made with you would generally require someone to hate you with all their being, be single mindedly devoted to whatever cause motivates them, or in some other way find breaking the oath to be the lesser problem

6.__source: Celestial Song v2 by Gothicjedi666 - The Smallfolk
6.name: Travel Supplies
6.description: A leather satchel which, when opened, contains the minimum needed to survive in the wild, as well as enough food for the day. Each day, the contents of the bag will change to cover this, with, for example, an arctic biome providing (among other things) warm clothes, firewood and a tinderbox, whilst a desert locale might provide thin, light, covering clothes, extra water and a tent. Once a week the perishables are replaced.

6.__source: Celestial Song v2 by Gothicjedi666 - The Smallfolk
6.name: Layered
6.description: The North is quite a frigid place even in summer, most will armour themselves in layers of leather. You on the other hand always have a perfect internal temperature no matter the clothes you are wearing if the weather is natural. The more unnatural the weather is the more likely you will need to wear appropriate clothing.

6.__source: Celestial Song v2 by Gothicjedi666 - The Smallfolk
6.name: Basic Supplies
6.description: (100): You have the necessary items to survive on the edges of society. This includes things like a tent and simple rations.

6.__source: Celestial Song v2 by Gothicjedi666 - The Smallfolk
6.name: Guest Right
6.description: Guest right is a practice that has and will continue to be one of the most sacred oaths and obligations any man owes to another, of safety under the roof of the man offering it. A guest is expected to respect their host, and the host is to see to the safety of their guest and do them no harm while they are under their roof. But sadly even the greatest of customs can be broken, and for one such as yourself, of the North where old customs run strong, it is a worrying thought. However, you will never have to worry about such a thing. So long as you respect your responsibilities as a guest or host, no harm shall be done to you, and no harm shall come to your guests while they are under your protection. This goes for oaths such as those of service as well. When men swear to serve you, they will, and will not even attempt to plot treachery against you. However, if you should stray from your own obligations, you will lose the protection of this perk.

6.__source: Celestial Song v2 by Gothicjedi666 - The Smallfolk
6.name: Of Flame and Forge
6.description: The forge answers to you. As a blacksmith of unparalleled skill, you can craft weapons, armor, and tools of unmatched quality. Beyond this, you possess one of the rarest talents in the world: the ability to reforge Valyrian Steel. You can repair shattered blades and reshape this legendary material into new forms without losing its signature sharpness, strength, or dark beauty.

6.__source: Celestial Song v2 by Gothicjedi666 - The Smallfolk
6.name: The Onion Knight
6.description: You are an amazing smuggler. This may not sound like much, but it comes with a host of benefits. You are a master sailor, capable of taming the fiercest of sea storms, and in addition, are truly superb at hiding things. When hiding things, you seem to be exceptionally good at causing people to overlook you, which stops officials and unwanted individuals from noticing your concealed cargo. This SEP field shorts out if A) your hidden items are physically discovered (eg. falling through a hidden door), or B) you rely solely upon it for protection. Finally, if you are ever caught, officials will be far less likely to hit you with the full punishment. You will still be punished, but the punishment itself will be drastically reduced in severity.

6.__source: Celestial Song v2 by Gothicjedi666 - The Smallfolk
6.name: Worker
6.source: A Song of Ice and Fire Jumpchain
6.description: You are willing to push yourself far beyond the normal limits with physical or tedious work. You will continue to do such tasks to the best of your ability without soon tiring.

6.__source: Celestial Song v2 by Gothicjedi666 - The Smallfolk
6.name: Dirty Fighter
6.source: A Song of Ice and Fire Jumpchain
6.description: You have picked up a lot of tricks in tavern brawls and are very capable at fighting cleverly (dirty). This will give you a significant edge against more honourable opponents.

6.__source: Celestial Song v2 by Gothicjedi666 - The Smallfolk
6.name: Bard
6.description: With an enchanting voice and the ability to easily remember lyrics you could have a second job as a bard. What separates you from the rest though is being able to quickly make a new song based on recent events or fake ones you want to perpetrate.

6.__source: Celestial Song v2 by Gothicjedi666 - The Smallfolk
6.name: Iron Price
6.description: When you kill an enemy you can take some of their possessions without any backlash if the killing is legal. Doing this will also increase the chance of more valuables being looted then they should normally have. This only works when the action leads you to taking the items.

6.__source: Celestial Song v2 by Gothicjedi666 - The Smallfolk
6.name: The Honorable Lord Stark
6.description: Most often - though not always - the Starks, a great deal of ASOIAF fic features a fast alliance being formed with the author’s favoured faction. Your ability to rapidly form strong mutual bonds, regardless of social status or the strangeness of a situation, is quite incredible, so long as you’re being genuine about it. As part of a group, you can rapidly rise in prestige and authority, so long as you discharge your duties well and prove worthy of the trust placed in you. You’re the exception to the whole notion that bad things must happen to good people. So long as you do your part honestly, sincerely and well, you find that anyone else you have a right to expect loyalty and service from does theirs just as genuinely too.

6.__source: Celestial Song v2 by Gothicjedi666 - The Smallfolk
6.name: Little(finger) Lies
6.description: You are one of the best liars and actors on the planet, easily deceiving virtually anyone as to your true intentions and feelings, and seamlessly mixing lies and truth to direct conversations exactly where you want them to go. You could get a man to trust you by explaining exactly why he shouldn’t trust you, and yet still have him be taken completely off guard by your sudden yet inevitable betrayal.

6.__source: Celestial Song v2 by Gothicjedi666 - The Smallfolk
6.name: Stranger
6.description: The Stanger’s Favor makes you into the very image of death. You have a preternatural level of skill and talent at all things stealthy, and can get in and out of just about anywhere, be it by intrusion or infiltration. You’re also similarly skilled in actually dealing death, whether by poisons, blade, or unfortunate accident. To make it clear, this perk makes you one of the finest assassins or spies in the setting, someone so deadly as to give the House of Black and White pause.

6.__source: Celestial Song v2 by Gothicjedi666 - The Smallfolk
6.name: Smith
6.description: With the Smith’s own gift in your arms and mind, you are a craftsman beyond peer, a maker of such wonders that lords and magisters would wage wars just for the chance to lay their hands on a piece you made. Be it smaller things like swords, armor or other crafts, or great feats of engineering and construction like Harrenhal or the Eyrie, your mind is flush with ideas and blueprints, making you a Smith, an Architect, an Engineer, and a Shipwright... and equally unmatched in all those fields.

6.__source: Celestial Song v2 by Gothicjedi666 - The Smallfolk
6.name: Making the Eight
6.description: Is a rather popular claim among the less... ‘proper’ lordlings of this world. And you’re one who might have a very real chance, even without bringing in the matter of your social status or wealth. You have a charm, an absolutely captivating charisma, that makes anyone you’re interested in putty in your hands. You know when to smile, when to laugh, what stories to tell to amuse and entice them... and how to satisfy, tire, or utterly break them in bed. Even when it comes to multiple partners at the same time, you have a gift for managing them and making them get along, not to mention, at times, having them develop similar attractions among themselves... regardless of how little sense it makes.

6.__source: Celestial Song v2 by Gothicjedi666 - The Smallfolk
6.name: Black Cloak
6.description: When worn, this item, not necessarily a cloak, grants you easy and instant admission into any organisation, no matter what requirements may normally be in place. To be clear, this item allows admission to ANY organisation including things like a rebellion as the person they’re rebelling against, the Maesters as a woman, the Seven Kingdoms as a wildling or other such ordinarily impossible to join groups. If you perform any actions against that organisation whilst a part of them (for example, sabotaging the rebellion you joined), then the protection of this item is revoked, and they’ll treat you like they would any other betrayer.

6.__source: Celestial Song v2 by Gothicjedi666 - The Smallfolk
6.name: Puppeteer
6.description: You can create extremely intricate puppets and use them in a show. Watchers will be drawn in by the stories and if you let your hands wander with specific figures you can tell the future. This comes with two puppets - one for each hand - which when held out of sight change to fit the story.

6.__source: Celestial Song v2 by Gothicjedi666 - The Smallfolk
6.name: Strength of the First Men
6.description: It is only right that the men of the North, last bastion of the First Men be strong of arm and heart. How else could your ancestors have thrown back the Andals and great Theon led the Northmen to destroy the Andal homeland? Regardless of the truth, you’ll find that you take after the general belief of Northern strength. While not supernatural, your body is strong and approaches what could be considered the peak of human strength, and learning to fight or becoming skilled in the ways of a warrior is much easier than it should be.

6.__source: Celestial Song v2 by Gothicjedi666 - The Smallfolk
6.name: Sellsword for Hire
6.description: Despite the feudal nature of this world, you have no trouble travelling the land, and can easily be hired by competing factions without them killing you. Want to work for Tyrwin, then go live in Sunspear? Go ahead. Want to live as a free folk then join the Umber’s household? Sure. Want to be a Night’s Watchmen, then leave? I guess. Essentially, despite anything you might normally expect, you may freely join or leave an organisation without consequence.

6.__source: Celestial Song v2 by Gothicjedi666 - The Smallfolk
6.name: Too Lowborn
6.source: A Song of Ice and Fire Jumpchain
6.description: People will very rarely consider you a threat. As long as you do nothing overtly threatening people will expect no harm from your direction.

6.__source: Celestial Song v2 by Gothicjedi666 - The Smallfolk
6.name: Horn of Joruman
6.source: A Song of Ice and Fire Jumpchain
6.description: A large, ornate and legendary hunting horn capable of massive destruction to even the largest of structures. Can only be used on a weekly basis but can bring practically any building (or Wall) tumbling down when blown.
